name: pi-transcribe
description: One transcribe() tool: speech in audio/video (talks, conversations, media URLs) becomes timestamped text. Two lanes (platform AI subtitles / local ASR), the calling model is the router. Fully local: no VLM, no cloud ASR. Not for video without speech
